verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online ships AI features (Intuit Intelligence, Payroll AI, Payments AI), so a buyer could fairly ask whether their data can be kept out of model training. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-usage control, or any AI training policy. The MCP server's write-disable toggles and the user-access roles are unrelated controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
